# Zakaria Teffah - Software Engineer (Full Content)

> Experienced software engineer with 14+ years building robust, high-performance software: architecture, algorithms, optimization, scientific computing and agentic AI. Based in Montpellier, France.

## Professional Summary

Software engineer with 14+ years building critical tools for industry leaders such as Airbus and Liebherr. I enjoy owning problems end-to-end: understanding the need, designing the architecture, and shipping tested, performant code.

Rigorous and adaptable, I ramp up quickly on new domains and technologies, and I leverage AI coding agents to speed up delivery. I care about code quality, testing and clear communication within a team.

## Core Competencies

- **C++**: Systems programming, performance-critical applications and low-level optimization.
- **Algorithms & Optimization**: Graph algorithms, combinatorial and numerical optimization, efficient data structures for large-scale problems.
- **Python**: Scripting, data analysis, ML prototyping, and rapid tool development for scientific computing.
- **Software Architecture**: Modular, maintainable designs built on the right abstractions, with testing and code quality in mind.
- **HPC**: Parallel computing, performance optimization, and scientific simulations on high-performance systems.
- **Agentic AI**: Leveraging AI coding agents, MCP tools and LLM workflows to accelerate design, development and testing.

## Professional Experience

### NanoXplore — C++/Python R&D Engineer
**Location**: Montpellier, France

C++ toolchain development for FPGA design software: graph/hypergraph algorithms, pattern matching, logic equivalence checking (BDD, SMT), performance optimization.

**Technologies**: C++, Python, Graph Algorithms, SMT Solvers, VHDL/Verilog, Testing

### Liebherr Aerospace — Scientific Tools Engineer
**Location**: Toulouse, France

Heat transfer algorithms for aircraft icing prediction, scientific computation library for roller bearing modeling, uncertainties propagation computation for sensor-dependent physical quantities.

**Technologies**: C++, Python, Scientific Computing, Numerical Optimization

### Airbus (via Altran) — Methods & Tools Consultant
**Location**: Toulouse, France

Airbus flight simulator stability optimization, aircraft trajectory simulation and optimization tools, multi-physics simulation for A30X wing optimization using kriging ML.

**Technologies**: C++, Optimization, Machine Learning, Design Patterns, Aerodynamics

### Internships

- **IMFT Toulouse** — Graduate Internship (Feb–Jun 2011): Finite volume code for Biot poro-elastic coupling simulation and numerical analysis.
- **Mercator Ocean** — Internship (Jun–Sep 2010, Toulouse): Generation of oceanic initial conditions from meso-scale oceanic re-analysis.
- **Norwegian Meteorological Institute** — Internship (Jul–Aug 2009, Oslo): OSI SAF daily ice drift product development and validation.
